## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D open-world creature adventure game in the existing repository.

## Requirements
- The game should be a Pokémon-style 2D experience with an open world, creatures, challenges, exploration, battles, quests, and save progress.
- Support desktop keyboard controls and mobile touch controls.
- No clarifying questions were requested.

## Decisions
- Used an original creature-adventure design named “Wildbound” to avoid directly copying Pokémon branding.
- Implemented the game as a self-contained browser app using HTML, CSS, Canvas, and JavaScript.
- Assumed a single-device local-save experience with 12 discoverable species and 4 challengers.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with the full game shell, canvas, battle UI, menus, team panel, quest panel, journal, and mobile controls.
- Created `style.css` with responsive desktop/mobile styling.
- Created `game.js` with:
  - open-world map and tile rendering
  - WASD, arrow-key, and touch movement
  - 12 creature species
  - wild encounters
  - trainer encounters
  - turn-based battle actions
  - capture, XP, leveling, switching, and healing systems
  - 4 challenger NPCs and 3 main crests plus a final champion
  - quest log, world map, field bag, journal, and team menus
  - localStorage saving
- Added a local static server on port 3002.
- Captured a browser screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/wildbound.png`.
- Verified `game.js` syntax with `node --check game.js`.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- Automated Playwright visual capture was blocked because the Playwright CLI expected `/home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/...`, while only `/usr/bin/chromium` was available.
- Chromium headless capture itself succeeded, so basic rendering can be visually inspected from `/tmp/opencode/wildbound.png`.

### Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/wildbound.png` for layout and runtime rendering issues.
2. Launch the game at `http://localhost:3002` and test movement, encounters, battles, capture, menus, and saving.
3. Fix any visual or gameplay defects discovered during testing.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Main game markup and UI structure.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/style.css`: Desktop/mobile layout and visual design.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/game.js`: Complete gameplay implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/wildbound.png`: Latest successful browser screenshot.

## Important Context
- The game uses `localStorage` under the key `wildbound-save`.
- Battle and team state are in-memory; the Save button writes the current state locally.
- The static server process is running via `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright CLI visual automation was not available because the configured browser executable was missing, despite Chromium existing system-wide.
